about_the_game:
Familiar Findings is a charming and cozy idle game with a magical twist. Join Avia, an aspiring mythozoologist, as she seeks to write and complete a magical grimoire of witches’ familiars. Summon familiars, collect their mana and complete fusion spells to discover new combinations.

Unlock New Companions

Sleeping Elder Dragons, grumpy ghosts and elegant capycorns are just some of the many familiars that wander and rest at the bottom of your screen. Try new fusion combinations to discover exclusive colour variants and higher rarities. Click on them to interact, each type has its own unique animations!

Your new desktop companions will keep you company while you do other things, whether that’s streaming, writing assignments or getting lost in internet rabbit holes.

Complete your codex

Each new discovery aids you in your research and brings you one page closer in completing your grimoire. Learn new facts about your familiars, track your progress and read Avia’s notes and musings.

Play that doesn't get in your way

Your familiars live at the bottom of your screen, but they won't stop you from being able to use any of your desktop! Your menu is tucked away when you’re not using it to give you a streamlined experience. There’s no distracting notifications or demanding grind mechanics that ruin your relaxation. Click and drag to move a familiar out of the way or scroll on Avia to quickly size everything up and down. Toggle reduced opacity mode to make it even easier to see what's going on behind!

Watch them enchant your screen without intruding while you work, study or relax. With over 100 variations there’s a favourite for everyone!
